verdict.rationale: mParticle's marketing describes a built-in agent ('One Agent across connected workflows'), so asking whether that agent can connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents MCP client support or any way to register third-party tool servers. The evidence covers only native integrations, APIs and an OpenAPI spec, none of which is plugging MCP servers into the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
